_comment: The survey spreadsheet column order, as one list that both sides are held to.
src/lib/survey.ts builds it from the questions; google-apps-script/mailing-list.gs
carries its own copy as SURVEY_HEADERS because it cannot import TypeScript.
tests/survey-questions.test.ts and tests/survey-gs.test.cjs each assert against
this file, so a question added on one side and not the other fails on the side
Order is the sheet. Appending is safe; inserting or renaming shifts every column
after it and misaligns rows already collected, exactly as with the Space Requests
